description: This PHP class 'ModuleScreenHelper' provides static utility methods for retrieving and resetting information about the current module and screen context within the OrangeHRM web application. It interacts with request objects and manages a singleton instance of 'ModuleScreen' to encapsulate the current module and screen identifiers based on URL path segments.

classes.name: ModuleScreenHelper
classes.description: A static helper class for managing and retrieving the current module and screen context based on the URL path in the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: getCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the current module and screen details by parsing the request path and stores it in a static variable for subsequent access.

methods.name: getCurrentRequest
methods.description: Fetches the current HTTP request object from the request stack service.

methods.name: resetCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Resets the stored module and screen information, clearing the singleton of 'ModuleScreen'.
